text:
miri-fin: Heads-up 11: ACME Labs opened a dispute for INV-2026-0721. They report a short microburst on 2026-07-18 that generated a $3,900 Dedicated overage on top of their $11,200 commit. They claim the traffic was a scheduled load-test but our allocator billed it as on-demand. Dropping here to propose a resolution.

billing-bot: Invoice INV-2026-0721 generated for ACME Labs  total $15,100 (overage $3,900). Payment due in 30 days.

alec-acct: CS says customer had coordinator-run load-test that should have used reserved token; their SDK sent the token but the token header was dropped at the edge during a quick TLS rekey. They want a full reversal of the overage.

pavan-eng: quick check: gateway logs show a 7-minute window with rekey events and 120s of truncated headers. Example: "2026-07-18T03:14:22Z REKEY start; 03:16:02Z REKEY complete" During that window many requests lacked the reserved-token header and were metered as on-demand.

pavan-eng: root cause looks like ephemeral edge process restart clearing in-flight header enrichment. we can harden header replay and make the SDK attach token in-body as fallback. won't retro-fix the billed events.

tia-cs: ACME is okay with a compromise if we offer a partial credit plus a free month of priority burst protection. They prefer quick closure.

nina-legal: legal: do not admit liability. Goodwill credit ok; include settlement language: "one-time reconciliation; no admission of fault; customer accepts credit as full settlement."

miri-fin: proposal: one-time reconciliation credit = 50% of the disputed overage ($1,950) + one month of burst protection up to $2,000 (priority routing during tests). Engineering to deliver SDK fallback and edge fix within 10 business days. Approve?

alec-acct: ACME product lead says 50% + the priority month is acceptable if we include a post-fix verification run and a brief runbook for future scheduled tests.

nina-legal: legal ok with that structure and release language. will prepare settlement snippet for CS to send.

pavan-eng: filing INFRA-7210: edge-rekey header persistence + SDK fallback. ETA: SDK change in 5 business days, edge hardening in 7. we'll provide test verification.

miri-fin: good. i'll draft provisional credit memo and mark invoice pending adjustment after signed settlement. leaving thread open until cs posts signed note and billing posts credit memo.
